summary: Teaching sampler: one Dye Essence patch driven by 12 controls. One sample (Dye's five built-in ones, or your own WAV) played across the keyboard, with a start offset past the attack, a tone tilt around 1 kHz, a crossfaded loop, a vintage grit stage (12 bits, a lower sample rate, tape wow) and a small room, with an ADSR, unison and an output gain. Every control says what it does and what you will hear. Use it for lo-fi keys, pads and drones from a sample, or to learn how a sampler shapes one recording.
use_for: A teaching sampler: lo-fi keys, pads and drones from one sample (five built in, or your own WAV) with a start offset, a tone tilt, a crossfaded loop, vintage grit and a small room.

parameters.name: Start Offset
parameters.description: Moves the sample playback start point forward past the initial recorded attack transient.
parameters.how: Moves the sample playback start point forward past the initial recorded attack transient.
parameters.sound: At 0% you hear the full natural hammer/pluck attack; raising it removes the transient for smooth, pad-like swells.

parameters.name: Tone
parameters.description: Tilts the spectrum around 1 kHz: a gentle low-pass to the left, a high shelf to the right.
parameters.how: Tilts the spectrum around 1 kHz: a gentle low-pass to the left, a high shelf to the right.
parameters.sound: Left sounds soft and dark, like a gentle touch; right sounds bright and present.

parameters.name: Source
parameters.description: Selects the sample played across the keyboard: Dye Essence's `Choir`, `Strings`, `Bell`, `Pluck`, `Texture`, or `User`, a WAV you load.
parameters.how: Selects the sample played across the keyboard: Dye Essence's `Choir`, `Strings`, `Bell`, `Pluck`, `Texture`, or `User`, a WAV you load.
parameters.sound: Changes the raw material every other control shapes.

parameters.name: Loop
parameters.description: 0% plays the sample once from the start offset; above 0% it loops a region after the offset, crossfaded, whose length grows with the value.
parameters.how: 0% plays the sample once from the start offset; above 0% it loops a region after the offset, crossfaded, whose length grows with the value.
parameters.sound: One-shot sounds stay natural; looping turns any sample into a sustained pad or drone.

parameters.name: Vintage Grit
parameters.description: Engages 12-bit amplitude quantization, sample-rate reduction, and subtle tape wow/flutter.
parameters.how: Engages 12-bit amplitude quantization, sample-rate reduction, and subtle tape wow/flutter.
parameters.sound: Transforms pristine studio recordings into nostalgic 90s hardware sampler and lo-fi tape textures.

parameters.name: Room Acoustic
parameters.description: Blends in stereo early reflections and natural studio room decay around the dry samples.
parameters.how: Blends in stereo early reflections and natural studio room decay around the dry samples.
parameters.sound: Places the instrument inside a realistic physical recording space rather than sounding dry and direct.

parameters.name: Attack
parameters.description: Sets the time required for the note's amplitude (and routed envelope modulation) to ramp from silence to full peak after a note-on trigger.
parameters.how: Sets the time required for the note's amplitude (and routed envelope modulation) to ramp from silence to full peak after a note-on trigger.
parameters.sound: Low values create immediate, percussive plucks; high values produce slow, swelling pads.

parameters.name: Decay
parameters.description: Controls how long it takes for the signal to drop from peak level down to the sustain level while a key remains held.
parameters.how: Controls how long it takes for the signal to drop from peak level down to the sustain level while a key remains held.
parameters.sound: Short decay makes notes snappy and tight; longer decay gives a gradual piano- or bell-like fade.

parameters.name: Sustain
parameters.description: Defines the steady-state volume level maintained for as long as a note is held after the Attack and Decay stages complete.
parameters.how: Defines the steady-state volume level maintained for as long as a note is held after the Attack and Decay stages complete.
parameters.sound: At 0% the synth behaves like a plucked or struck instrument; at 100% it holds full organ-like volume.

parameters.name: Release
parameters.description: Sets the time required for the sound to fade from its current level to complete silence after the note is released.
parameters.how: Sets the time required for the sound to fade from its current level to complete silence after the note is released.
parameters.sound: Short release stops notes abruptly; long release leaves an ambient tail that blends chords together.

parameters.name: Unison / Spread
parameters.description: 0% plays one voice per note; above 0% each note plays 5 detuned, stereo-spread voices (3 in Additive, Granular and Spectral), with detune (up to ±50 cents) and width growing with the value.
parameters.how: 0% plays one voice per note; above 0% each note plays 5 detuned, stereo-spread voices (3 in Additive, Granular and Spectral), with detune (up to ±50 cents) and width growing with the value.
parameters.sound: Thickens thin waveforms into wide, chorus-like stereo leads and pads.

parameters.name: Output
parameters.description: Sets the level after synthesis. There is no limiter (NeoBuzz mixes in floating point); a clip light shows when the output passes 0 dBFS.
parameters.how: Sets the level after synthesis. There is no limiter (NeoBuzz mixes in floating point); a clip light shows when the output passes 0 dBFS.
parameters.sound: Controls overall loudness; keep the clip light dark when the next machine expects levels at or below 0 dBFS.

imports.description: A WAV sample (mono or stereo, up to 20 s, kept in the machine state): the sample the Source control's User choice plays
